answer_1.quote: This paper evaluates Wav2Prompt on diverse spoken language tasks including speech translation (ST), spoken language understanding (SLU), and spoken-query-based question answering (SQQA)...
answer_1.outputs: Translated text, answers to spoken queries, and intent classifications

answer_2.quote: Case-sensitive detokenised BLEU results are reported to evaluate translation quality... For the SLU task, accuracy was used to measure the intent classification... ASR performance was also evaluated using word error rate (WER)... Accuracy was used as the metric.

answer_3.quote: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 was used to evaluate the accuracy of the model prediction in the SQQA task. The accuracy was computed by counting the frequency with which the Mistral LLM outputs 'yes'.
